credits.title: Heysel 85
credits.overview: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.

credits.title: The Claus Family 2
credits.overview: Jules Claus has embraced Christmas again and is getting ready for the busiest time of the year together with grandpa Noël. Everything seems to go according to plan, until Jules receives a very special letter with an intriguing question...

credits.title: Cruise Control
credits.overview: Life does not go well the last couple of years for film director Serge Gabriëls. Since the day he chose his career above the woman of his life, things kept going downhill. credits.title: Pieter Verelst: Amai
credits.overview: Pieter Verelst’s signature humor is on full display in his show “Amai,” interspersed with musical touches. The show explores his generation, materialism, love, relationships, and anxiety.

credits.title: Pieter Verelst: Mijn Broer en Ik
credits.overview: In his first comedy special the Flemish comedian Pieter Verelst tells a bizarre story about his childhood, which he spent with his brother (existing or not) in a boring village in Flanders. Together they tackle this dullness and use it as a source of inspiration for a strange creativity.

credits.title: Paradise Trips
credits.overview: Holiday bus driver Mario has spent his entire life shuttling old age pensioners to the sunny south with his own travel company 'Paradise Trips'.
